<thought>To propose a one‑step retrosynthesis, I will look for a reaction template that converts a carbonyl (C=O) into an exocyclic alkene (C=C) via a Wittig olefination. I will search the template catalog for a forward reaction that forms a C=C bond while breaking a C=O bond. Once a suitable template is found, I will verify that the required precursors (the corresponding ketone and a methylene phosphonium ylide precursor) are commercially available and together cost less than $250. Finally, I will construct the JSON route using the identified template ID.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
